data.title: Rosehill
data.about:
Introducing Rosehill by Emaar Properties, a landmark golf-front residential complex located in the prestigious Dubai Hills Estate. The project features 1, 2 and 3-bedroom residences, starting from AED 1.6M, with thoughtfully designed interiors that open out to lush fairways and expansive greenery.

Residents will enjoy direct access to the Dubai Hills Championship Golf Course, as well as nearby destinations including Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai Hills Park, King’s College Hospital, and Emaar Business Park. With proximity to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and top international schools, Rosehill at Dubai Hills Estate is a rare opportunity to live in one of Dubai’s most coveted locations.

characteristics_module.title: Dubai’s Next Icon of Golfside Living
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location in Dubai Hills Estate: Positioned in one of Dubai’s most prestigious master communities, strategically located between Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina.
  • Strong Capital Appreciation Potential: Golf-course facing properties in Dubai Hills historically show higher resale value and long-term appreciation.
  • High Rental Demand & Yields: A preferred area for high-income tenants seeking luxury lifestyle and connectivity, ensuring strong rental returns.
  • Proximity to Top Landmarks: Located close to Dubai Hills Golf Club, near Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai Hills Park, King’s College Hospital, and top international schools.
  • Excellent Connectivity: Emaar Rosehill at Dubai Hills Estate offers direct access to Al Khail Road with 15–20 min reach to Downtown, Business Bay, and Dubai International Airport.
  • Proven Track Record of Sell-Outs: Follows the success of sold-out launches like Club Place, Golf Hillside, and Vida Club Point, indicating strong market demand.
  • Lifestyle-Centric Community: Integrated with wellness, retail, leisure, and green spaces, ideal for end-users and investors alike.
  • Attractive Entry Price Point: Starting from AED 1.6M, offering exceptional value for a golf-facing branded property in Dubai.
  • Developer Credibility: Developed by Emaar, globally recognized for delivering high-quality communities and sustained investor returns.

location_tile.title: Experience Golf View and Parkside Luxury
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Perfectly positioned between Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina, Dubai Hills Estate offers a perfectly balanced lifestyle with urban accessibility and serene surroundings. As a master-planned community by Emaar, it features lush green spaces, tree-lined boulevards, and a championship golf course at its heart. Residents of Rosehill will enjoy seamless connectivity via Al Khail Road and easy access to top landmarks like Dubai Hills Mall, Emaar Business Park, and King's College Hospital. 

  • 5 minutes to Dubai Hills Mall
  • 4 minutes to Dubai Hills Park
  • 5 minutes to King's College Hospital
  • 5 minutes to Emaar Business Park
  • 15 minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 15 minutes to Dubai Marina
